_comment: Hot-path criterion baseline: the median ns of each bench in crates/bench/benches/hot_path.rs, keyed by the id the bench gives `bench_function` (criterion's `full_id`), gated by `make bench-check` (check_regression.py) at `tolerance_pct`.

Host: the Apple M4 Pro. Re-baselined 2026-09-25 at 5f2140f, each value the median of three `make bench-check` runs (warm-up 1 s, 2 s, 50 samples) with the launchd engine running, as it always is. The values before were a 2026-05-19 Linux aarch64 sandbox run that the check never compared on this Mac: it looked for results under a path this criterion does not write.

book/apply_n8_middle and strategy/latency_arb_on_tick_no_fire have not been the sandbox's 0.94 / 1.66 ns since phase 8a: the initial commit's code (02db7a6) measures 1.07 / 1.69 ns on the M4, 5f2140f 1.99 / 2.47 ns. Both benches repeat one tick, so every apply after the first is stale, and D10 (503606f) made a stale apply count itself (`stale_drops += 1`, a read-modify-write per call) where it used to return.
Not gated: ring/spsc_rtt_tick and ring/spsc_stream_tick, two threads that macOS places as it likes (103-122 ns and 9-11 ns across sessions); docs/risk-policy.md records them.
Re-baseline when a change moves a number on purpose: three `make bench-check` runs, each value their median, and the reason recorded here and in docs/risk-policy.md.

HK9 (2026-10-13, at 2f842e6): vol/long_day_close_warm, vol/long_state_copy_warm and signer/hypercall_place_order baselined, each the median of three `make bench-check` runs with the engine running (load 9.4-11.3); the eleven above were left as they are (all within 15 %, none moved on purpose). bin15/late_fair_in_window and bin15/late_grid_mark_and_perp_1s (BIN15 H90) stay unbaselined for that lane: the second spread 1.6-2.3 ns across runs.

HK16 (2026-10-14, at c24557d): bin15/late_fair_in_window and bin15/late_grid_mark_and_perp_1s baselined, each the median of five runs with bench-check's settings (warm-up 1 s, 2 s, 50 samples) with the engine running (load 9.6): 335.2-342.9 ns and 1.597-1.621 ns, so neither moved more than 1.5 % across the five. HK9's 1.6-2.3 ns spread did not recur.

S16-1 (2026-10-16, at 0432bfa): strategy_set/on_tick_all, on_tick_none, on_fill_routed and on_timer_all baselined on the hand-written fan-out, BEFORE S16-1 generated it from the member table, so the table is held to the code it replaced. Each value is the median of three runs with bench-check's settings (warm-up 1 s, 2 s, 50 samples) with the engine running (load 8-10): 4.626-4.631, 2.2548-2.2554, 1.7541-1.7543 and 2.2555-2.5056 ns (on_timer_all: 2.256 twice, 2.506 once).

S16-2 (2026-10-16, at afdc431 + the S16-2 change): strategy_set/on_tick_none re-baselined 2.26 -> 2.51 ns. That is one cycle, and it comes from LLVM's block layout, not from the u16 mask test: the test compiles to `ldrh`+`tbz` where it was `ldrb`+`tbz`, but LLVM placed the blocks of the ~7k-instruction inlined `on_tick` differently and no longer rotates hcv's bit-7 test to the loop head. Interleaved A/B, three runs each, with bench-check's settings and the engine running (load 13-16): A (afdc431) 2.265 / 2.333 / 2.258 ns, B (S16-2) 2.510 / 2.509 / 2.513 ns; the value is B's median. With the per-slot arrays put back to 8, B still measured 2.507 ns, so the arrays are not the cause. on_tick_all (the production path), on_fill_routed and on_timer_all did not move (A/B equal within 0.03 ns) and keep their S16-1 values.

S16-3 (2026-10-16, at d911044 + the S16-3 change): ledger/locate_miss and ledger/locate_hit baselined (the router ledger's resting-table lookup a live fill, cancel or modify pays; an XMM requote pays two). LEDGER_RESTING 512 -> 1 024 doubled the full-table scan (the reviewer's scratch A/B on the M4 Pro: a miss ~150 -> ~280 ns warm p50, ~0.9 us cold); the high-water mark `resting_hi` bounds every scan to the live prefix, so the cost follows the rows resting, not the table. With eight rows resting, the median of three runs with bench-check's settings (warm-up 1 s, 2 s, 50 samples) with the engine running (load 10-12): miss 3.009 / 3.032 / 3.310 ns, hit (a queued modify's asked hold, idempotent) 6.578 / 6.775 / 6.848 ns. The twenty above stayed within 15 % on the same build (on_timer_all at its known 2.51 ns mode, +10.9 %).
